Lessons

  1. 01 Water goes upBefore rain can fall, water has to reach the sky. It travels there as a gas you cannot see. 1 minNot started
  2. 02 Clouds are made of dropletsA cloud looks solid, but it is a crowd of tiny drops of liquid water. Here is how the vapour turns back into liquid. 1 minNot started
  3. 03 From droplet to raindropCloud droplets are far too small to fall. This is how they grow heavy enough to reach the ground, and what shape they are when they do. 1 minNot started
